name: get_cluster
description: Gets the details of a specific GKE cluster.

parameters.description: MCPGetClusterRequest gets the settings of a cluster.

name.description: Required. The name (project, location, cluster) of the cluster to retrieve. Specified in the format `projects/*/locations/*/clusters/*`.

readMask.description: Optional. The field mask to specify the fields to be returned in the response. Use a single "*" to get all fields. Default: autopilot,createTime,currentMasterVersion,currentNodeCount,currentNodeVersion,description,endpoint,fleet,location,name,network,nodePools.locations,nodePools.name,nodePools.status,nodePools.version,releaseChannel,resourceLabels,selfLink,status,statusMessage,subnetwork.
